시편-86-1.title: 시편 86장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-86-1.exegesis: 12-13. and, under this, the deserted land shall be productive, and men be "set," or guided in God's holy ways. Doubtless, in this description of God's returning favor, the writer had in view that more glorious period, when Christ shall establish His government on God's reconciled justice and abounding mercy.

시편-86-2.title: 시편 86장 2절 역사문법적 주해
시편-86-2.exegesis: PSALM 86 Psa 86:1-17 . This is a prayer in which the writer, with deep emotion, mingles petitions and praises, now urgent for help, and now elated with hope, in view of former mercies. The occurrence of many terms and phrases peculiar to David's Psalms clearly intimates its authorship. 1-2. poor and needy-- a suffering child of God, as in Psa 10:12 , 17 ; 18:27 . I am holy-- or, "godly," as in Psa 4:3 ; 85:8 .
